source.note: the one sentence in the registered block that names the put->move workaround; R174 row 1

entries.text: If a "put" action repeatedly fails despite being at the correct location and holding the object, try the alternative phrasing "move <object> to <receptacle>"; if that also fails, try a different valid receptacle of the same type, and if the receptacle is a container, ensure it is open first.
